7.  2019 vs 2018: Americas 16.8% > 15% (increase), Europe 56.8% < 58.4% (decrease) → **counts**
8.  2020 vs 2019: Americas 17.3% > 16.8% (increase), Europe 56.4% < 56.8% (decrease) → **counts**
